Step 3: get_next_batch_to_run() - pad to JIT bucket - build ForwardBatch pytree

Step 5: ZMQ to DetokenizerManager - incremental decode - stream to client

Step path: tokenize - prefix match - bucket pad - JIT forward - Pallas KV update - detokenize - stream - repeat
